top_signals.title: Pimco’s Balls Sees Good Value in Long End of Yield Curve
top_signals.summary: Andrew Balls, global fixed income CIO at Pimco, says one to two further interest-rate hikes from the Federal Reserve “seems reasonable” as the central bank targets a return to 2% inflation. He also explains why he sees “good value” in the long end of the Treasury yield curve amid uncertainty around artificial intelligence. He speaks on “Bloomberg Surveillance.” (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
